title: Why AMPK Reads AMP, Not ATP

scenes.tts: Is there enough A T P? A healthy cell holds its A T P nearly constant, so A T P is a poor alarm. The kinase A M P K reads A M P instead.
scenes.caption: Is there enough ATP? A healthy cell holds its ATP nearly constant, so ATP is a poor alarm. The kinase AMPK reads AMP instead.
scenes.visual: A flat ATP trace labelled nearly constant, crossed out as an alarm; an AMP chip glows and AMPK chip reads it.
scenes.narration: Is there enough ATP? A healthy cell holds its ATP nearly constant, so ATP is a poor alarm. The kinase AMPK reads AMP instead.

scenes.tts: Adenylate kinase keeps the three adenine nucleotides near equilibrium. Two A D P make one A T P and one A M P. Divide by A T P. The A M P to A T P ratio goes as the square of the A D P to A T P ratio.
scenes.caption: Adenylate kinase keeps the three adenine nucleotides near equilibrium. Two ADP make one ATP and one AMP. Divide by ATP. The AMP to ATP ratio goes as the square of the ADP to ATP ratio.
scenes.visual: Two ADP chips reversibly become ATP and AMP chips; the two equations are written; the square is highlighted.
scenes.narration: Adenylate kinase keeps the three adenine nucleotides near equilibrium. Two ADP make one ATP and one AMP. Divide by ATP. The AMP to ATP ratio goes as the square of the ADP to ATP ratio.

scenes.tts: At rest, A T P is five millimolar and A M P is point zero two five. Let work use up a tenth of the A T P. A T P falls to four and a half, A D P settles near point nine three, and A M P becomes point zero nine six. A T P fell ten percent, and A M P rose almost fourfold. The needle has barely moved, and the light is on.
scenes.caption: At rest, ATP is five millimolar and AMP is point zero two five. Let work use up a tenth of the ATP. ATP falls to four and a half, ADP settles near point nine three, and AMP becomes point zero nine six. ATP fell ten percent, and AMP rose almost fourfold. The needle has barely moved, and the light is on.
scenes.visual: Table of mM values at rest, bars as percent of resting value change after work; a fuel gauge needle barely moves and a lamp lights.
scenes.narration: At rest, ATP is five millimolar and AMP is point zero two five. Let work use up a tenth of the ATP. ATP falls to four and a half, ADP settles near point nine three, and AMP becomes point zero nine six. ATP fell ten percent, and AMP rose almost fourfold. scenes.tts: In A M P K, alpha carries the kinase, beta holds the complex together, and gamma carries the sensor. A M P, A D P and A T P compete for sites on gamma, so gamma reads their ratio. The main switch is one threonine on alpha, phosphorylated by L K B one. With A M P on gamma, that phosphate is harder to remove, and by most accounts easier to add. A M P moves most, so A M P K reads A M P.
scenes.caption: In AMPK, alpha carries the kinase, beta holds the complex together, and gamma carries the sensor. AMP, ADP and ATP compete for sites on gamma, so gamma reads their ratio. The main switch is one threonine on alpha, phosphorylated by LKB1. With AMP on gamma, that phosphate is harder to remove, and by most accounts easier to add. AMP moves most, so AMPK reads AMP.
scenes.visual: Three subunit blobs; nucleotide chips compete at gamma; LKB1 adds a phosphate to Thr 172 on alpha; AMP on gamma shields the phosphate.
